questions.question: During the night, how did Jesus come to His disciples in their boat as the wind and waves beat against it?
When Peter saw Jesus walking on the sea toward the disciples' boat, what did Peter ask Jesus to do?

answers.text: Command Peter to come on the water
Let Peter climb up into the boat

questions.question: As Peter walked on the water toward Jesus, what did he see that made him afraid and begin to sink?
After Jesus saved Peter from sinking, when did the strong wind finally die down?

answers.text: When they climbed back into the boat
When Peter cried out for help
When Jesus spoke to the wind
